about.title: From startup code to millions-scale: my journey as a Software Engineer.
about.p1: My path in software started in 2018 in Fortaleza, when I joined Deway as an intern. What began with Ionic and React Native at a mobile-focused startup turned into six years of steady growth, eventually leading me to Tech Lead. There I solidified my core stack—React, Next.js, Node.js, and Python—and led projects from zero to production.
about.p2: In 2024 I took on a role at RD Saúde (Latin America's largest drugstore retailer), where I owned complex technical solutions: shaping architecture, joining coding dojos, and driving quality through code reviews and high-level technical discussion.
about.coodexBefore: Since 2025 I've been at Coodex, contributing to
about.coodexAfter: —prompt engineering and full-stack work with Next.js, Vue.js, NestJS, and AWS on an AI-driven commissioning platform.

coodex.introBefore: Coodex builds AI-powered platforms for asset-heavy industries; I work on
coodex.introAfter: , a commissioning and EPC data platform powered by vertical AI agents—shipping features end to end with a strong focus on LLM-backed workflows.
coodex.bullet1: Prompt engineering and iteration on AI-assisted flows, aligning model behaviour with product and compliance needs in production.
coodex.bullet2: Full-stack delivery with Next.js, Vue.js, NestJS, and AWS—APIs, UIs, and cloud plumbing for reliable releases.

rd.intro: RD Saúde is Latin America's largest drugstore retailer. I joined to own technically demanding initiatives where architecture decisions, collaboration, and quality gates directly affect millions of customers.
rd.bullet1: Led design and delivery of complex solutions—from high-level architecture to hands-on implementation.
rd.bullet2: Ran coding dojos and deep code reviews to raise the bar on engineering practices and shared ownership.
rd.bullet3: Partnered with product and leadership on technical trade-offs, prioritizing reliability and maintainability at scale.

deway.intro: I started in Fortaleza as an intern at a mobile-focused startup. What began with Ionic and React Native turned into six years of growth—ending as Tech Lead—shipping products from zero to production alongside a growing team.
deway.bullet1: Consolidated a core stack around React, Next.js, Node.js, and Python; led projects across discovery, build, and deploy.
deway.bullet2: Mentored engineers, shaped technical direction, and balanced delivery speed with long-term quality.
deway.bullet3: Deep experience in mobile and web ecosystems, from hybrid apps to full-stack features in production environments.

sports.title: Sports
sports.subtitle: Passion
sports.p1: I follow sports closely—especially basketball and football (soccer). Watching games, reading about athletes, and seeing how teams prepare is something I genuinely enjoy alongside work and music.
sports.p2: Two athletes I look up to are Stephen Curry and Cristiano Ronaldo. I'm a huge fan of both: Curry's work ethic, humility, and clutch mindset; Ronaldo's discipline, longevity, and obsession with improvement. Their mentalities inspire how I show up in my own career—consistency, resilience, and always pushing the next step.

music.p1: Music is a huge part of my life—I listen to almost everything, from hip-hop and electronic to rock, MPB, and whatever catches my ear. I don't stick to one genre; I enjoy discovering new sounds and revisiting old favorites.
music.p2: I also go to a lot of live shows. There's nothing quite like being in the crowd, and some of my best memories are from concerts. Below is a clip from one of them—a Travis Scott show—with me in the frame.
